name: GonkaRouter
description: Router on the Gonka network handing new accounts 1M free tokens, no card.
overview: GonkaRouter routes to models running on the Gonka decentralised network through an OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible API at api.gonkarouter.io/v1. Signing in with email or Google gives 1,000,000 free tokens as a one-time welcome grant, with no card and no wallet needed. The catalogue lists GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4-Flash and MiniMax-M2.7 at $0.0057 per million tokens and up, and topped-up accounts get 20% bonus credit plus higher concurrency.
free_access: 1M free tokens as a one-time signup grant
Email or Google sign-in, no card and no crypto wallet needed
Paid top-ups add 20% bonus credit and higher concurrency
notes: Sibling of Gonka Broker, which is a separate product with a separate monthly phone-verified grant. This entry is the router, whose 1M tokens do not renew.
